description: Source code for the Zephyr RTOS driver for the Stellaris Ethernet Controller, including initialization, packet transmission, reception, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_assign_mac
methods.description: Assigns the MAC address to the hardware registers based on device tree property.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_flush
methods.description: Flushes the current transmit word buffer to the hardware.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_send_byte
methods.description: Queues a byte for transmission, handling partial word assembly.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_send
methods.description: Transmits a network packet by sending its length and payload to the hardware.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_rx_error
methods.description: Handles receive errors by resetting the RX buffer and updating error stats.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_rx_pkt
methods.description: Reads a received Ethernet frame from hardware into a net_pkt buffer.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_rx
methods.description: Processes incoming packets, placing them into the network interface queue.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling Ethernet controller interrupts.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_init
methods.description: Initializes the network interface, assigns MAC, and sets up interrupts.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_dev_init
methods.description: Performs device-specific initialization, including MAC assignment and register setup.

methods.name: eth_stellaris_irq_config
methods.description: Configures and enables the Ethernet controller interrupt.
